study: Predeclared B64 slow numerical qualification, no timing
speed_definition: Smooth contact direction, force, friction and radius use time=speed*frame; release/reset/shock event frames remain fixed. Different speeds cover different total smooth paths in 80 frames, rather than the same path in different times.
cross_batch_rounding_note: Mass-relief dense matrix products can use different reduction order for B16 and B64; SHA is checked within the same batch.

row.outputs: all declared mother top/bottom local in-plane stress components
